The JSON schemas of OME-NGFF (OME-Zarr) 0.6, copied unmodified from
https://github.com/ome/ngff-spec/tree/cf2d4e994981bc7a368c569b1622b32c6ab2aab1/schemas
for tests/test_ome_warp.py, which validates the deformation records' metadata.
